example: COIN, CRCL, HOOD, JPM, V, PYPL
federal_character: Dividends qualified or ordinary; gain capital
holding_period_rule: More than 1 year is long-term (0/15/20% federal)
income_timing: Dividend when paid; gain on sale
ca_conformity: CA conforms generally; CA taxes all gain as ordinary rate up to 13.3%; no preferential rate
notes: Qualified dividend needs holding period over 60 days in 121-day window. Federal 2026 LTCG 0% to $49,450 single, 15% to $545,500 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec 4.03). NIIT 3.8% above MAGI threshold.

example: IBIT, FBTC, ETHA, SOL ETPs (non-staking)
federal_character: Gain or loss capital; no dividends; trust expenses reduce basis or are sales of fractional units
holding_period_rule: Holder treated as owning fractional interest in trust assets; more than 1 year is long-term
wash_sale_applies: Unclear (shares are securities but holder is treated as owning underlying property; no authority; bill H.R. 10357 pending)
income_timing: On sale of shares; trust sales of coins to pay fees are small taxable dispositions passed to holder by reporting
ca_conformity: CA conforms generally; CA taxes all gain as ordinary rate up to 13.3%; no preferential rate
notes: Not collectibles: Sec 408(m) text names no digital assets; 28% collectibles rate not applied to crypto in current IRS guidance (not fetched). Step-up at death applies.

example: Staking-enabled grantor trust ETPs (single-asset, e.g. ETH or SOL)
federal_character: Staking rewards ordinary income to holder; gain on sale capital
holding_period_rule: Same as grantor trust ETP
income_timing: Rewards income when trust gains dominion and control; trust must distribute or sell net rewards within 60 days after quarter end (Rev. Proc. 2026-20)
reporting_form: 1099-B plus trust tax information statement; for 2026 statement to trust interest holders due 2027-03-15
ca_conformity: CA conforms generally; CA taxes all gain as ordinary rate up to 13.3%; no preferential rate
notes: Rev. Proc. 2025-31 (2025-11-10) superseded by Rev. Proc. 2026-20 (2026-10-06); six-month transition to about 2027-04-06; safe harbor for single-asset trusts per RSM. IRS expresses no view on ECI or UBTI.

example: BLOK, BKCH, tokenization equity ETFs
federal_character: Qualified or ordinary dividends; capital gain distributions; gain capital
holding_period_rule: More than 1 year is long-term
income_timing: Distribution when paid
ca_conformity: CA conforms generally; CA taxes all gain as ordinary rate up to 13.3%; no preferential rate
notes: RIC rules. Look through underlying holdings for foreign issuers: foreign dividends may not be qualified.

example: BITO and similar futures-based ETFs; commodity-pool trusts
federal_character: RIC form: dividends (ordinary mostly) from futures gains; partnership-pool form: 60/40 via K-1
holding_period_rule: RIC: fund-level; holder holding period on shares. Pool: Sec 1256 60/40 mark-to-market passes to holder
wash_sale_applies: Y for RIC shares; Unclear for pool units
income_timing: Distributions (RIC) or annual K-1 allocation (pool) regardless of cash
sec1256: Y at fund level only if regulated futures contract; holder gets 60/40 only through K-1 pool (Unverified per prospectus)
ca_conformity: CA conforms to 1256 but taxes at ordinary rates
trad_ira_ok: Y (K-1 pools may create UBTI risk low)
notes: Structure varies by fund. Check each prospectus; the 60/40 benefit is lost in a RIC. Cannot confirm any fund structure this session.

example: BTC, ETH, SOL, LINK held self-custody or on exchange
federal_character: Property: capital gain or loss; ordinary if dealer or earned
holding_period_rule: Day after acquisition; more than 1 year is long-term
wash_sale_applies: N for directly held (Sec 1091 text has no digital asset language); H.R. 10357 would extend
income_timing: Sale, exchange, spend are taxable events; crypto-to-crypto swap taxable
reporting_form: 1099-DA (gross proceeds after 2025; basis for covered units acquired after 2025 in custodial account); 8949
ca_conformity: CA conforms; ordinary rates up to 13.3% on gains
trad_ira_ok: Via self-directed IRA custodian only (practical limits)
notes: Specific ID by unit; broker custody after 2025 needs broker identifiers. Rev. Proc. 2024-28 basis allocation was one-time for units held 2025-01-01. Not a collectible under 408(m) text.

example: ETH, SOL, ADA staking from own wallet or exchange
federal_character: Ordinary income at FMV when dominion and control; later gain or loss capital
holding_period_rule: Holding period of reward tokens starts day after receipt
wash_sale_applies: N (as property); Unclear if reward tokens reacquire same asset
income_timing: FMV when taxpayer gains dominion and control (Rev. Rul. 2023-14; Paschall, T.C. Memo. 2026-46)
reporting_form: Not on 1099-DA (staking excluded per instructions); Form 1040 other income or Sch 1
ca_conformity: CA conforms to federal income recognition; Unverified FTB position
notes: Jarrett (M.D. Tenn.) refund conceded 2022 without merits; no final ruling found. Paschall (2026) holds rewards taxable in year received. Pending bills would allow 5-year deferral election (draft only).

example: Token airdrops, hard fork assets
federal_character: Ordinary income at FMV when dominion and control (Rev. Rul. 2019-24)
holding_period_rule: Day after receipt
income_timing: When recorded on ledger and taxpayer can dispose
ca_conformity: CA conforms generally
notes: Hard fork with no new asset is not income. Soft fork is not income. Treasury guidance on airdrops contemplated in bills only.

example: USDC, PYUSD held
federal_character: Property; gain or loss capital, usually near zero
holding_period_rule: Day after acquisition
income_timing: Sale or spend taxable; de minimis proposals pending ($200 draft, $300 Lummis)
reporting_form: 1099-DA; optional broker aggregate: no report if total gross proceeds $10,000 or less
ca_conformity: CA conforms; no de minimis
notes: Paying with stablecoin triggers a (tiny) disposal. Track basis anyway. Draft de minimis safe harbor requires regulated payment stablecoin.

example: Exchange or platform rewards on stablecoin balances
federal_character: Ordinary income (interest or other income) when received; no qualified dividend treatment
holding_period_rule: Reward tokens start new holding period
income_timing: When credited and withdrawable (dominion and control)
ca_conformity: CA conforms; ordinary
notes: Character is inference, no authority found. If product is a loan of tokens, disposition risk unresolved. Legality of issuer-paid yield is WS2 scope (GENIUS Act).

example: Franklin BENJI (FOBXX), other 1940 Act government MMF shares on ledger
federal_character: Ordinary dividends (not qualified); interest-related dividend rules for foreign holders only
holding_period_rule: Share price stable; gain rare
income_timing: Dividends when declared or reinvested; each token reinvestment is not a sale
ca_conformity: Exempt-interest pass-through only for portion from US obligations if fund meets 50% quarter-end test (R&TC 17145); SBE: only the exempt percentage passes
notes: Treasury-only funds usually pass test; repo-heavy government funds pass less. Fund issues annual percentage; use it on Sch CA. FTB Pub 1001 not retrievable (403).

example: BlackRock BUIDL and similar private or offshore-domiciled tokenized funds
federal_character: Ordinary income; if non-US corporation, PFIC regime applies
holding_period_rule: Excess-distribution regime absent QEF or mark-to-market election
income_timing: Dividends; PFIC elections change timing
pfic_risk: Y (likely if foreign corporation; domicile not verified this session)
ca_conformity: CA generally follows PFIC; no state-exempt pass-through unless qualifying RIC
taxable_ok: N for Retail (qualified purchaser or accredited limits)
notes: Most are not open to non-accredited investors. Domicile of each vehicle must be checked in its offering document.

example: Tokenized wrapper holding T-bills directly (e.g. Ondo OUSG style, trust or SPV)
federal_character: Interest ordinary; federal taxable; state exemption only if holder is treated as owning Treasuries directly
holding_period_rule: Accrual or distribution per structure
wash_sale_applies: Y if security; Unclear for token claims
income_timing: Interest when received or accrued per structure
pfic_risk: Y if offshore SPV elects corporate status
ca_conformity: State-exempt only with look-through; CA exempts US obligations interest if direct or via qualifying fund
notes: Structure-dependent; many are Reg S or Reg D only. Treat character as Unverified until offering memorandum read.

example: Tokenized loan fund interests (Reg D)
federal_character: Interest ordinary via partnership K-1; fees; possible ECI for foreign and UBTI for IRA
holding_period_rule: Partnership holding period
income_timing: Annual K-1 allocation, phantom income possible
ca_conformity: CA conforms to partnership rules; LLC fee for entities
notes: Not available to the personal case. Mid and Large tiers only.

example: Cayman or BVI tokenized funds, offshore yield funds
federal_character: Ordinary income and interest charge on excess distributions (top rate plus interest) unless QEF or MTM
holding_period_rule: Holding period of PFIC stock; gains taxed as ordinary under excess distribution
income_timing: Excess distribution regime or annual QEF or MTM inclusion
ca_conformity: CA follows federal PFIC income; no relief
notes: PFIC tests: 75% passive income or 50% passive assets (Sec 1297; not fetched this session, training basis). MTM election available for marketable stock.

example: Robinhood or Kraken tokenized stocks, offshore wrapped equity
federal_character: No authority: probably property or derivative; dividend equivalents likely ordinary, not qualified
holding_period_rule: Unclear; treat as property held over 1 year for long-term
income_timing: Dividend equivalents when paid
reporting_form: 1099-MISC or none; 1099-DA if token is a digital asset
pfic_risk: Y if issued by offshore fund-like SPV
ca_conformity: CA conforms if federal treatment follows
taxable_ok: Y if platform offers to CA residents
notes: No IRS guidance on legal-share tokens vs synthetic. 1099-DA instructions cover dual-classification tokenized securities (details not retrieved).

example: Pre-IPO common or preferred of C-corp, Reg D
federal_character: LTCG; Sec 1202 exclusion may apply federally
holding_period_rule: Over 3 years: 50%; 4 years: 75%; 5 years: 100% for stock issued after 2025-07-04; cap $15M or 10x basis; assets under $75M
income_timing: On sale; no income before
qsbs_eligible: Y if C-corp, active business, original issue, gross assets $75M or less; financial services excluded under 1202(e)(3) (training; not fetched)
ca_conformity: DIVERGES: CA does not conform to Sec 1202; full gain taxed at up to 13.3%
notes: Stock issued on or before 2025-07-04 keeps old rules: 5-year, 100%, $10M cap. Cap indexed after 2026. Many crypto firms may fall in excluded financial-services fields; confirm per issuer.

example: VC or growth fund LP interest
federal_character: Pass-through: LTCG, ordinary, QSBS flow-through possible
holding_period_rule: Carried interest Sec 1061: 3-year holding for carry LTCG (training; OBBBA change not verified)
wash_sale_applies: Y at fund level only for trading; rare
income_timing: K-1 annually
pfic_risk: Y if offshore blocker or fund
qsbs_eligible: Y flow-through if fund holds QSBS
ca_conformity: CA conforms to partnership rules; no QSBS
notes: Carry and UBTI are Mid and Large issues. Verify Sec 1061 status.

example: Running validators, delegated staking business
federal_character: Business income: ordinary, self-employment tax 15.3% to wage base then 2.9%; rewards at FMV when dominion
holding_period_rule: Rewards start new holding period
income_timing: Receipt of rewards; business deductions Sch C or partnership
reporting_form: 1040 Sch C; 1065; not 1099-DA (validation excluded from broker definition)
pfic_risk: N (US entity); Y if offshore foundation
ca_conformity: CA conforms; LLC fee and tax possible
notes: No validator-specific guidance on SE tax; mining treated as SE income under Notice 2014-21 (training). Entity choice and nexus are CPA matters.

example: Bank-issued notes linked to BTC ETP or crypto equities
federal_character: Ordinary if contingent payment debt or coupons; capital on prepaid forward if so treated; character per prospectus tax section
holding_period_rule: Debt: holding periods irrelevant for OID; forward: more than 1 year
income_timing: OID accrues annually for CPDI; coupons when paid
ca_conformity: CA conforms
notes: Tax treatment is stated in each prospectus and is unsettled for some structures (Notice 2008-2 context, training).

example: CME BTC and ETH futures, options on those futures
federal_character: Sec 1256: 60% long-term, 40% short-term, marked to market at year-end
holding_period_rule: No holding period test; year-end mark-to-market
wash_sale_applies: N (Sec 1256 contracts outside Sec 1091 for most purposes; loss rules differ)
income_timing: Annual mark-to-market whether or not closed
sec1256: Y (regulated futures contract on a qualified board per Sec 1256(g)(1); text has no digital asset language)
ca_conformity: CA conforms to 1256 but taxes as ordinary income; no benefit from 60/40 rate
taxable_ok: Y (futures cash account limits apply; Retail suitability)
notes: Margin account needed; personal case is cash account only. 1256 loss carryback election exists (Sec 1212(c), training).
